Each candidate name is normalized once, charged once by examineSourceRecord, validated against its typed record identity and owner, and inserted into the existing family map.
Kept family coverage checks separate; no new pointer vector, counter, persistent fixture, API member, virtual, or object state was added.
Added a private-method test friend and generated typed/raw MLINESTYLE cap/refusal/retry control.
